title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 18.Calls on the Commission and the Member Statesto strictly apply the principle of subsidiarity, ensuring that EU humanitarian funding is provided only where EU action demonstrably adds value and where objectives cannot be effectively achieved by the Member States or local authorities; insists that EU humanitarian funding should be strictly limited to life-saving humanitarian activities and should not be used, directly or indirectly, to finance political advocacy, ideological campaigning or activities unrelated to immediate humanitarian assistance; calls on the Commission to strengthen anti-fraud mechanisms, systematically recover misused funds and suspend or permanently exclude organisations that fail to comply with financial, legal or transparency requirements from future EU funding;
